# R1 original external-evidence execution preservation

This directory preserves the original completed R1 external-evidence-contract execution, exact HEAD 2a86462a1ab20c68151719ba4635e3c294391e64 and tree 5c26776f96f15fd131e85a5c2d7c5e895ad7fab4. All 12 original stages exited 0; the lane took 213.820 seconds under its unchanged 2,700-second limit. The original readiness suite reported 78 methods / 34.516 seconds / OK. Four source records are byte-identical to the independently pinned 423-byte source identity. The original 14-object map was verified and fetched remained empty.

All 27 original files are present under flat/original/. The complete closed-directory inventory contained no nested log files; none were omitted. The unchanged original driver, approved packaging producer and pinned closed-log manifest are also expanded. The complete 31-member ZIP has been verified by CRC, bytes and SHA256 on both hosts, and official version-pinned transfer and actual PTY provenance are retained.

This is separate local R1 external evidence. It does not substitute for the original repository-truth lane or separate W1 control suite, and it confers no hosted or later-revision qualification. Historical failed and UNKNOWN records are unchanged. No tests, source/Git actions, publication or stage materialization were performed by this preservation.
